title: Sector Research: Oil & Exploration
body: A new Sectors tab with deep, source-confirmed research on one sector at a time. The first covers Oil & Exploration: the 2026 Gulf supply shock, India's production, gas pricing and exploration policy, and what it all means for 29 listed producers, service and pipe companies, gas utilities and refiners. It cites 140 sources, is refreshed monthly, and its company numbers update daily.

title: Alerts: new highs, new lows and breakouts
body: The bell in the top bar lists every company making a new 1-day, 1-week, 1-month, 6-month or 1-year high or low, plus IPO base and base breakouts, after each session. Choose what you follow in Alert settings: your watchlist, the board or the whole market.

title: Your account menu
body: Dark mode, your profile, these updates, saved filters and a way to write to us - all saved to your account.

title: Watchlists are now saved to your account
body: Star a company once and it is on your watchlist on every device you log in from. Nobody else sees it.

title: Deep-dive research reports
body: Forensic reports modelled on an institutional initiation note - business, customers, order book, accounting quality, governance, valuation and risks, every claim labelled and cited. A few are added every day and each is refreshed after the company's quarterly results.

title: Research Reports for every company
body: A full report page for every company on the board, printable or saved as a PDF.

title: Companies added automatically every morning
body: The daily 7 AM screen adds companies that pass the board's gates and state a moat in their own words, marked Auto-added.
